questions.answer: Easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Some don't like when you speak English (and not italian) thats a bit frustrating

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: hmm.. really liked living there and have time to explore and - ate a lot of pasta and drank aperol :)) as mentioned before the uni is not challenging so you have a lot of time to just chill around

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: There is no deadlines.. thats just how it is - and they can't tell you what they expect in terms of exams and so - but don't stress - the expectations are low. Have fun w all the other exchange students and travel around in Italy. We went on weekend trips to Como all the time.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I don't think so

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: All my new friends - got the best girlfriend group - and we are all from Copenhagen - sounds boring to go to italy and meet danish people but at the same time it is ver unique to get so close so quick and get new bff - you don't get that when you are in DK w your fam and friends because you don't have time.

questions.answer: Idk
